column11: Leqvio, CMS Medicare Part B 2024 (drug_demand): $296,288,761.40 over 48,298 beneficiaries = $6,134.80 per beneficiary a year. Part B is the right anchor of the two the dossier prints: Leqvio is administered by a healthcare professional (LEQVIO prescribing information, section 2.2) and 48,298 of its 50,979 Medicare beneficiaries in 2024 sit in Part B against 2,681 in Part D. For scale, the labelled-year allowed amount is $6,787.60: the same CMS file gives $296,288,761.40 over 24,794,466.1 dosage units = $11.9498 a mg (HCPCS J1306 is 'injection, inclisiran, 1 mg'), and a steady-state labelled year is 284 mg every 6 months, 568 mg (LEQVIO prescribing information, NDA 214012, section 2.1: '284 mg administered as a single subcutaneous injection initially, again at 3 months, and then every 6 months'). CMS's October 2026 Part B payment limit file puts J1306 at $12.897 a mg, $7,325.50 a labelled year
column12: a price per patient treated in a year. $6,134.80 / $6,787.60 = 0.9038, which is the share of a labelled year the stopping row below derives from dosage units per beneficiary, so the two are one measurement and the shortfall is counted once rather than twice. Leqvio is the one product in this book whose per-beneficiary figure is close to a full labelled year, because two injections a year is a schedule almost everyone completes; backend/gross_to_net.py names it as the top of the range it measured

J1306 is 'injection, inclisiran, 1 mg' and a steady-state labelled year is 568 mg (two 284 mg doses six months apart, LEQVIO prescribing information), so a beneficiary averages 0.9038 of a labelled year on drug and 1 - 0.9038 = 0.0962. column12: the Opdivo method (amgn_abp_206.csv), measured on the same beneficiaries the price above is quoted on. Two errors pull in opposite directions and neither is removed. A patient's first twelve months carry three doses, not two (months 0, 3 and 9), so a cohort that is half new starters should consume more than 568 mg if nobody stopped, which means true stopping is higher than 9.6%; against that, a beneficiary who starts in December is counted in the denominator for one dose, which pulls the ratio down for a reason that is not stopping. Leqvio's Medicare beneficiary count roughly doubled again in 2024 (24,690 to 48,298), so both effects are large. Read 0.0962 as the lower bound of a range whose upper end is the 0.1346 the 2023 file gives

column11: already approved. LEQVIO is indicated 'as an adjunct to diet and exercise to reduce low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) in: adults with hypercholesterolemia' (NDA 214012, label effective 2026-08-19, openFDA drug/label). The indication carries no atherosclerotic-disease restriction, no prior-event requirement and no LDL-C threshold, so the enrolled populations of both trials on this unit are already inside it: NCT05360446 enrols non-obstructive coronary artery disease without previous cardiovascular events on maximally tolerated statin therapy, and NCT05739383 (14,012 participants) enrols high-risk primary prevention. A patient on a maximally tolerated statin has hypercholesterolemia; that is why the statin is there. These patients are inside the 1,198mm USD the marketed line is anchored on
column12: what the two readouts can move is the claim and the payer position, not the eligible population, and that is why no pool is seeded. The label already carries a class statement - 'Cardiovascular outcomes trials have demonstrated that reducing LDL-C lowers the risk for major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) in adults at increased risk when treated with statins or monoclonal antibody proprotein convertase subtilisin kexin type 9 (PCSK9) inhibitors as an add-on to statin therapy' - which is not inclisiran's own outcome. VICTORION-2P would replace it with one. The book prices that through the marketed line's growth rate, where it belongs, rather than through a layer that would sell the same patients a second time. The dossier prints the ASCVD pool for this disease; it is deliberately not copied here, per the brief's rule that an approved indication gets overlap 1.0 and no pool
